title: Ethical AI Proxy
summary: A lightweight CORS proxy that lets Ethical Tech CoLab GitHub Pages demos make live calls to the Claude API or GPU-hosted models without exposing API keys in browser code.

narrative.problem: GitHub Pages is static hosting: a demo there cannot hide API keys, because everything is visible in the browser, cannot make server-side API calls, and cannot get past CORS restrictions to reach the lab's own GPU server.
narrative.decision: A small server, run on the GPU server or any server, holds the API keys, allowlists GitHub Pages origins, rate-limits requests and forwards them to the Claude API or to one configured GPU inference server; a browser client helper offers ask, stream and GPU calls.
narrative.tradeoff: Keys never reach the browser, but every AI-enabled demo now depends on a separately operated server staying up, and the GPU route forwards only to the configured server, so it deliberately cannot act as a general relay.
narrative.limitation: The README covers setup, endpoints and security controls but reports no tests, load evaluation or deployment record; operators must supply their own process management (pm2 or systemd) and configuration.
